meta.description:
The Official Pingu Youtube Channel! 

Check out this funny and silly little penguin, Pingu! Along with his mom, dad, little sister, and all his friends, Pingu gets himself into some exciting and fun adventures in his snowy world. Subscribe to our channel so you can be the first to watch great Pingu videos on YouTube!
